translations.web: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for it is Yahweh your God who fights for you, as he spoke to you.
translations.bsb: One of you can put a thousand to flight, because the LORD your God fights for you, just as He promised.
translations.kjv: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised
translations.asv: One man of you shall chase a thousand; for Jehovah your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he spake unto you.
